name: Benfield Control Systems Inc.
old_description: LV and MV power distribution equipment, including switchgear up to 38kV class
about:
Benfield Electric Supply Co. Inc. was founded in 1951 in Mount Vernon, New York, and remains independently owned. The company began as a wholesale electrical distributor serving the New York metropolitan area.

Today Benfield operates across six divisions — electric supply, data communications, electric and elevator supply, control systems, lighting, and international — from two locations in Mount Vernon and White Plains. A fleet of 24 service trucks supports same-day pickup and next-day delivery across New York City and the Lower Hudson Valley. The company maintains a broad inventory of electrical distribution equipment, wire, cable, conduit, lighting, and control products from hundreds of manufacturers. In-house capabilities include UL508a-listed control panel fabrication, SCADA and power monitoring system design, PLC/HMI software development, value engineering, and pre-fabrication services, all backed by RCDD-certified data engineers and FOA-certified fiber optic technicians.

Benfield serves industrial enterprises, original equipment manufacturers, construction and engineering contractors, manufacturing firms, and healthcare institutions such as Weill Cornell Medical Center and Lutheran Medical Center. Its project portfolio spans electrical distribution, data communications, power systems, HVAC, elevator equipment, lighting, and renewable energy installations including solar, wind, and EV charging infrastructure. The international division supplies U.S. and foreign engineering and construction contractors worldwide.

The company credits its longevity to independent ownership that allows flexibility and a relationship-focused approach, as well as deep community ties through local hiring and charitable involvement. Recognition such as the Westchester 50 award underscores its economic contribution. Benfield emphasizes combined staff experience exceeding 400 years and a service model that integrates project management from design through delivery.
